title: Our Favorite Memories
subtitle: Some moments become memories. Some memories become forever. ❤️
scatteredNotes: I wish I could relive this.

memories.title: The Night We Finally Met
memories.alt: The two of us close together, a quiet, warm moment
memories.story:
I still remember when I came to your house to meet you… and somehow, that night became one of those memories I'll never forget.

And then we kissed on Dessura night. ❤️

It was such a simple moment, but for me, it meant so much. Because it wasn't just a kiss. It was one of those moments where everything we had been feeling suddenly felt real.

Even now, whenever I think about that night, I can't help but smile. That night became a little piece of us that I'll always keep in my heart. ❤️
memories.whyItMatters: Because it was one of the first moments where our feelings weren't just words anymore. I could actually feel how close we had become.

memories.title: Your First Pharmacy Birthday With Me
memories.alt: The two of us together with a bouquet of flowers, celebrating
memories.story:
I still remember celebrating your birthday during your 1st year of Pharmacy. 🎂❤️

It wasn't just about celebrating your birthday. For me, it was about being there with you on a day that was special to you. Seeing you happy made the whole moment special for me too.

I loved being able to celebrate you, even if it was just one little chapter of our journey together. Looking back, I realize how precious these simple moments are. Your happiness somehow became my happiness too. ❤️
memories.whyItMatters: Because I don't just want to remember the big romantic moments. I want to remember the moments where I was simply there beside you, celebrating your life and watching you smile.

closing.title: And there are still so many more… ❤️
closing.text:
These are only a few of the moments I've collected in my heart.

There are still so many laughs, so many calls, so many little adventures, so many stupid jokes, so many hugs, and so many moments that I never want to forget.

And the best part? Our story isn't finished yet.

There are still so many memories waiting for us. So many more photographs waiting to be taken. 📸❤️
